images.title: A box with its faces and vertices
images.purpose: Show the concept's box as a wire frame with 8 numbered vertices, the three faces that meet at one vertex tinted, and the counts of faces and vertices written beside it.
images.composition: One box in the left of the frame with three tinted faces and eight numbered vertices (one hidden), and three lines of text on the right.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. One box (a matchbox shape) drawn as a wire frame with its three visible faces tinted, on the left of the frame. VERTICES (8 dots, 18 px, dark #2B2B2B, the hidden one hollow with a white fill): 1 front bottom left (250, 600), 2 front bottom right (610, 600), 3 front top right (610, 360), 4 front top left (250, 360), 5 back top left (400, 250), 6 back top right (760, 250), 7 back bottom right (760, 490), 8 back bottom left (400, 490), hollow because it is hidden. EDGES, 12 straight lines (5 px, dark #2B2B2B): 9 solid lines 1 to 2, 2 to 3, 3 to 4, 4 to 1, 4 to 5, 3 to 6, 5 to 6, 2 to 7, 6 to 7, and 3 dashed grey #6B7280 lines (5 px, dash 14 px, gap 10 px) for the hidden edges 8 to 7, 8 to 5 and 8 to 1. TINTED FACES, 3 visible faces, flat fills at 45 percent opacity under the lines: the top face with corners (250, 360), (610, 360), (760, 250), (400, 250) teal #0072B2; the front face with corners (250, 600), (610, 600), (610, 360), (250, 360) amber #E69F00; the right face with corners (610, 600), (760, 490), (760, 250), (610, 360) reddish purple #CC79A7. VERTEX NUMBERS in bold dark #1F2937 sans-serif (30 px), centred at: 1 at (222, 628), 2 at (640, 630), 3 at (592, 335), 4 at (222, 338), 5 at (372, 226), 6 at (790, 226), 7 at (792, 515), 8 at (372, 470). FOCUS RING: a green #009E73 ring (44 px across, 5 px thick, no fill) around vertex 3 at (610, 360), where the top, front and right faces meet. A thin grey #6B7280 leader line (3 px) from (634, 360) to (868, 360). TEXT on the right, left-aligned at x 880, dark #1F2937 (40 px): 6 faces, all rectangles at y 250; 3 faces meet at this vertex at y 360; 8 vertices at y 470. In all: 8 vertex dots and 8 numbers, 12 edges (9 solid, 3 dashed), 3 tinted faces, 1 ring, 1 leader line and 3 text lines. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any count of vertices, edges, faces or numbers that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
the hidden vertex drawn as solid, or the hidden edges drawn as solid lines
a box that is not drawn as a box with 6 rectangle faces
images.takeaway: A box has 6 faces, all rectangles, and 8 vertices, and at every vertex 3 faces meet.
images.description: A box drawn as a wire frame with 8 numbered vertices, the top, front and right faces tinted where they meet at one vertex, and the text 6 faces, 8 vertices and 3 faces meet at this vertex.
images.context: Concept image for Faces and Corners of a Solid. It shows the concept's own box and not a figure from your maths book.
images.teaching_notes: Turn a real matchbox while the child ticks each face once. The slip to watch is missing the hidden back vertex and counting 7 vertices.

image_decisions.why: The box drawn with all 8 vertices, the three faces at one vertex and the hidden back corner is the mathematics: the child counts faces and vertices from the picture.
